[devoteam-new-joiners-hub (6).html](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31908414/devoteam-new-joiners-hub.6.html)
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Devoteam | New Joiners Hub</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;1,300;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --pink:#F8485E;        /* Red Poppy — Devoteam primary */
    --pink-dark:#D93850;   /* darker Poppy for hover states (not an official swatch) */
    --pink-light:#FCA2AE;  /* Poppy Light — official secondary */
    --pink-tint:#FDDADE;   /* Poppy Lighter — official secondary */
    --grey:#3C3C3A;        /* Dark Grey — Devoteam primary */
    --grey-soft:#6B6B68;
    --white:#FFFFFF;
    --bg-tint:#EFEEEE;     /* Light Grey — official secondary */
    --border:#E4E2E1;
    --radius:10px;         /* buttons, inputs, nav elements */
    --radius-card:15px;    /* cards, per Devoteam brand guidelines */
    --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(60,60,58,0.04), 0 4px 16px rgba(60,60,58,0.06);
    --shadow-hover:0 2px 4px rgba(60,60,58,0.06), 0 12px 28px rgba(60,60,58,0.10);
    --shadow-deep:0 8px 24px rgba(60,60,58,0.08), 0 24px 64px rgba(60,60,58,0.12);
    --maxw:1120px;
    --ease:cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
    *{animation-duration:.001ms !important;animation-iteration-count:1 !important;transition-duration:.001ms !important;scroll-behavior:auto !important;}
  }
  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:'Montserrat',system-ui,sans-serif;
    font-weight:400;
    color:var(--grey);
    background:var(--white);
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,h4{
    font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
    margin:0;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
    color:var(--grey);
  }
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px;}
  @media (max-width:640px){.wrap{padding:0 20px;}}
  .section{padding:88px 0;position:relative;}
  @media (max-width:640px){.section{padding:56px 0;}}
  .section.tint{background:var(--bg-tint);}

  /* ===== SCROLL REVEAL ===== */
  .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .7s var(--ease), transform .7s var(--ease);}
  .reveal.in-view{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}

  /* ===== TEXT REVEAL (clip-path wipe, Awwwards-style masked entrance) ===== */
  .text-reveal{position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .text-reveal-inner{
    display:inline-block;clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0);transition:clip-path .85s var(--ease);
  }
  .text-reveal.in-view .text-reveal-inner{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);}

  /* ===== PRELOADER / CURTAIN INTRO ===== */
  #preloader{
    position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:var(--grey);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    transition:transform .7s var(--ease) .15s, opacity .5s ease .15s;
  }
  #preloader .pl-mark{
    font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-weight:800;color:var(--white);font-size:15px;
    letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;opacity:0;
    animation:plFade .5s ease .1s forwards;
  }
  #preloader .pl-mark .pl-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink);animation:pulseDot 1s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes plFade{to{opacity:1;}}
  #preloader.pl-hide{transform:translateY(-100%);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    #preloader{display:none;}
  }

  /* ===== NAV TRANSITION SWEEP (brief color pulse when jumping sections) ===== */
  #navSweep{
    position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:190;background:var(--pink);
    transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top;pointer-events:none;
    transition:transform .35s var(--ease);opacity:.16;
  }
  #navSweep.sweep-active{transform:scaleY(1);transition:transform .3s var(--ease);}
  #navSweep.sweep-out{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom;transition:transform .35s var(--ease) .05s;}
  .reveal-stagger.in-view{transition-delay:calc(var(--stagger-i, 0) * 70ms);}

  /* ===== STAGE KICKER (journey narrative label) ===== */
  .stage-kicker{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--grey-soft);margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  .stage-kicker .stage-num{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--grey);color:var(--white);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .eyebrow{
    font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.09em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--pink);margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  }
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:16px;height:2px;background:var(--pink);display:inline-block;}
  .placeholder{
    display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--pink-dark);
    background:var(--pink-tint);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;letter-spacing:0.02em;
  }
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    padding:12px 22px;border-radius:var(--radius);font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;
    border:1.5px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s ease;font-family:inherit;
  }
  .btn-primary{background:var(--pink);color:var(--white);}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--pink-dark);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);}
  .btn-ghost{background:transparent;border-color:var(--border);color:var(--grey);}
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--grey);background:var(--bg-tint);}
  .btn-sm{padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px;}
  .btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;}

  /* ===== NAV ===== */
  header{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  }
  nav.wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:72px;gap:16px;}
  .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;}
  .logo img{height:26px;width:auto;display:block;flex-shrink:0;}
  .logo .dot{width:10px;height:10px;background:var(--pink);border-radius:2px;}
  .logo-divider{color:var(--border);font-weight:400;}
  .logo-sub{color:var(--grey-soft);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;}
  @media (max-width:1300px){
    .logo-divider, .logo-sub{display:none;}
  }
  .nav-links{display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;flex-shrink:1;}
  .nav-links a{
    padding:9px 9px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--grey-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);
    transition:all .15s ease;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--grey);background:var(--bg-tint);}
  .nav-links a.active{color:var(--pink);}
  .nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
  .search-box{position:relative;}
  .search-input{
    width:190px;padding:9px 14px 9px 34px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);
    font-family:inherit;font-size:13.5px;transition:all .15s ease;background:var(--white);
  }
  .search-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--pink);width:240px;}
  .search-icon{position:absolute;left:11px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:14px;opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;}
  .search-results{
    position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);right:0;width:320px;background:var(--white);
    border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);
    max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto;display:none;z-index:200;
  }
  .search-results.show{display:block;}
  .search-result-item{padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;transition:background .12s;}
  .search-result-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .search-result-item:hover{background:var(--bg-tint);}
  .search-result-item .r-title{font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;}
  .search-result-item .r-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--grey-soft);margin-top:2px;}
  .search-empty{padding:16px;font-size:13px;color:var(--grey-soft);}
  .hamburger{display:none;background:none;border:none;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--grey);}
  .mobile-drawer{
    display:none;position:fixed;inset:72px 0 0 0;background:var(--white);z-index:99;
    padding:16px 20px;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;overflow-y:auto;
  }
  .mobile-drawer.show{display:flex;}
  .mobile-drawer a{padding:14px 8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
  @media (max-width:860px){
    .nav-links{display:none;}
    .search-box .search-input{width:150px;}
    .hamburger{display:block;}
  }

  /* ===== HERO ===== */
  .hero{position:relative;}
  .hero-stage{
    position:relative;min-height:min(80vh, 660px);display:flex;align-items:center;
    padding:120px 0 76px;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero-stage-bg{
    position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
    background-image:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,);
    background-size:cover;background-position:center 58%;
    transform:scale(1.04);
  }
  .hero-stage-scrim{
    position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;
    background:linear-gradient(175deg, rgba(32,18,24,.38) 0%, rgba(32,18,24,.64) 52%, rgba(24,14,18,.88) 100%);
  }
  .hero-trails{
    position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;opacity:.4;mix-blend-mode:screen;
    background:
      linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 40%, rgba(248,72,94,.35) 48%, rgba(252,162,174,.5) 50%, rgba(248,72,94,.35) 52%, transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(112deg, transparent 55%, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 61%, transparent 66%);
    background-size:220% 220%;
    animation:trailDrift 22s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes trailDrift{
    0%{background-position:0% 30%;}
    50%{background-position:80% 60%;}
    100%{background-position:0% 30%;}
  }
  .hero-stage-content{position:relative;z-index:3;}
  .hero-eyebrow{
    font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pink-light);
    margin-bottom:22px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  }
  .hero-eyebrow .pulse-dot{
    width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink-light);flex-shrink:0;
    animation:pulseDot 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulseDot{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);}50%{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.75);}}
  .hero-stage h1{
    font-size:clamp(38px, 6.4vw, 82px);line-height:1.03;font-weight:800;max-width:920px;letter-spacing:-0.025em;
    color:var(--white);text-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
  }
  .hero-stage h1 .hl{color:var(--pink-light);}
  .hero-stage p.sub{font-size:clamp(16px,1.6vw,19px);color:rgba(255,255,255,.86);max-width:580px;margin-top:24px;line-height:1.6;}
  .hero-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:36px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .hero-stage .btn-ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);color:var(--white);}
  .hero-stage .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--white);background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);}
  .scroll-cue{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:64px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
    color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .scroll-cue .chev{animation:cueBounce 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;font-size:14px;}
  @keyframes cueBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);}50%{transform:translateY(5px);}}
  .hero-journey-wrap{padding-top:64px;}

  /* ===== JOURNEY PATH (signature element) ===== */
  .journey{margin-top:88px;}
  .journey-track{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;}
  .journey-line{
    position:absolute;top:11px;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:var(--border);z-index:0;
  }
  .journey-line-fill{
    position:absolute;top:11px;left:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--pink),var(--pink-dark));z-index:1;
    transition:width .6s var(--ease);width:0%;
  }
  .journey-step{position:relative;z-index:2;flex:1;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .25s var(--ease);}
  .journey-step:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);}
  .journey-dot{
    width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--white);border:3px solid var(--border);
    margin-bottom:16px;transition:all .25s var(--ease);
  }
  .journey-step.filled .journey-dot{border-color:var(--pink);background:var(--pink);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(248,72,94,.14);}
  .journey-step:hover .journey-dot{border-color:var(--pink);}
  .journey-step h4{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--grey);}
  .journey-step p{font-size:13px;color:var(--grey-soft);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4;}
  @media (max-width:760px){
    .journey-track{flex-direction:column;gap:26px;}
    .journey-line,.journey-line-fill{display:none;}
    .journey-step{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;}
    .journey-dot{margin-bottom:0;margin-top:2px;flex-shrink:0;}
  }

  /* ===== QUICK ACCESS ===== */
  .qa-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:28px;}
  @media (max-width:1000px){.qa-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}}
  @media (max-width:640px){.qa-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
  .qa-card{
    background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-card);padding:20px 16px;
    display:block;transition:all .18s ease;
  }
  .qa-card:hover{border-color:var(--pink);box-shadow:var(--shadow-deep);transform:translateY(-4px);}
  .qa-icon{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:10px;display:block;}
  .qa-title{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;}
  .qa-sub{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--grey-soft);margin-top:3px;}

  h2.section-title{font-size:32px;font-weight:700;}
  p.section-lead{font-size:16px;color:var(--grey-soft);max-width:620px;margin-top:12px;line-height:1.6;}

  /* ===== CHECKLIST ===== */
  .progress-bar-wrap{
    background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:20px 24px;margin-top:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;
  }
  .progress-bar-track{flex:1;height:8px;background:var(--bg-tint);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;}
  .progress-bar-fill{height:100%;background:var(--pink);width:0%;transition:width .4s ease;border-radius:4px;}
  .progress-label{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;}
  .checklist-groups{margin-top:36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
  .cl-group{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-card);background:var(--white);overflow:hidden;}
  .cl-group-header{
    padding:18px 22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:between;gap:12px;cursor:pointer;
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  }
  .cl-group-header h3{font-size:16.5px;}
  .cl-group-count{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--grey-soft);font-weight:600;}
  .cl-group-chevron{transition:transform .2s ease;font-size:13px;color:var(--grey-soft);}
  .cl-group.open .cl-group-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg);}
  .cl-group-body{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .3s ease;}
  .cl-group.open .cl-group-body{max-height:1200px;}
  .cl-item{
    display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:13px 22px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .cl-checkbox{
    width:20px;height:20px;border:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px;
    cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:all .15s ease;
  }
  .cl-checkbox.checked{background:var(--pink);border-color:var(--pink);}
  .cl-checkbox.checked::after{content:"✓";color:white;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;}
  .cl-text{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;}
  .cl-text.done{color:var(--grey-soft);text-decoration:line-through;}

  /* ===== TOOL CARDS ===== */
  .tools-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:36px;}
  @media (max-width:760px){.tools-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .tool-card{
    border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-card);background:var(--white);padding:26px;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;transition:all .18s ease;
  }
  .tool-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-deep);transform:translateY(-3px);}
  .tool-card.mandatory{border-color:var(--pink);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--pink-tint),white 40%);}
  .tool-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
  .tool-icon{font-size:28px;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--bg-tint);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
  .tool-card.mandatory .tool-icon{background:var(--pink-tint);}
  .tool-name{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;}
  .tool-tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--pink-dark);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .tool-desc{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--grey-soft);line-height:1.55;}
  .tool-meta{font-size:13px;color:var(--grey);background:var(--bg-tint);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:4px;line-height:1.5;}
  .tool-meta b{font-weight:700;}
  .tool-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:auto;flex-wrap:wrap;}

  /* ===== 30/60/90 TIMELINE ===== */
  .timeline{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;margin-top:36px;}
  .tl-row{display:flex;gap:28px;padding:28px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
  .tl-row:first-child{border-top:none;}
  .tl-marker{width:120px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .tl-marker .tl-day{font-family:'Montserrat';font-weight:700;font-size:19px;color:var(--pink-dark);}
  .tl-marker .tl-label{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--grey-soft);margin-top:2px;}
  .tl-body h4{font-size:16px;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .tl-body ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;font-size:14px;color:var(--grey-soft);line-height:1.7;}
  .tl-body ul li strong{color:var(--grey);font-weight:600;}
  @media (max-width:640px){.tl-row{flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}.tl-marker{width:auto;}}

  /* ===== HR / PEOPLE CARDS ===== */
  .hr-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:32px;}
  @media (max-width:760px){.hr-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .hr-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-card);padding:20px 22px;background:var(--white);}
  .hr-card h4{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .hr-card p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--grey-soft);line-height:1.55;margin:0;}

  /* ===== CONTACTS ===== */
  .contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:32px;}
  @media (max-width:860px){.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media (max-width:600px){.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .contact-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-card);padding:22px;background:var(--white);}
  .contact-card .c-icon{font-size:22px;}
  .contact-card h4{font-size:15px;margin:10px 0 6px;}
  .contact-card p{font-size:13px;color:var(--grey-soft);margin:0 0 10px;line-height:1.5;}

  /* ===== FAQ ===== */
  .faq-search{margin:32px 0 8px;position:relative;}
  .faq-search input{
    width:100%;padding:14px 16px 14px 42px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);
    font-family:inherit;font-size:15px;
  }
  .faq-search input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--pink);}
  .faq-search .search-icon{left:16px;font-size:16px;}
  .faq-list{margin-top:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
  .faq-item{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-card);background:var(--white);}
  .faq-q{
    padding:18px 20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;
    font-weight:600;font-size:15px;gap:12px;
  }
  .faq-chevron{transition:transform .2s ease;color:var(--pink);flex-shrink:0;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg);}
  .faq-a{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .3s ease;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-a{max-height:400px;}
  .faq-a-inner{padding:0 20px 18px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--grey-soft);line-height:1.6;}
  .faq-hidden{display:none;}

  /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
  footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:40px 0;background:var(--bg-tint);}
  footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;}
  footer p{font-size:13px;color:var(--grey-soft);margin:0;}

  .anchor-offset{scroll-margin-top:90px;}
  .badge-mandatory{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--pink);color:white;
    font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:4px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase;
  }

  /* ===== JOURNEY RAIL (fixed stage indicator, desktop only) ===== */
  .journey-rail{
    position:fixed;right:26px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:80;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;
  }
  .rail-dot{
    position:relative;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border);
    transition:all .25s var(--ease);cursor:pointer;display:block;
  }
  .rail-dot.active{background:var(--pink);transform:scale(1.5);}
  .rail-dot .rail-label{
    position:absolute;right:20px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);white-space:nowrap;
    background:var(--grey);color:var(--white);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:6px;
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .18s ease;letter-spacing:.02em;
  }
  .rail-dot:hover .rail-label{opacity:1;}
  @media (max-width:1180px){.journey-rail{display:none;}}

  /* ===== AI COMPANION ===== */
  .ai-tab{
    position:fixed;right:0;top:68%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:150;
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--grey);color:var(--white);
    padding:14px 16px 14px 18px;border-radius:14px 0 0 14px;cursor:pointer;border:none;
    font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-deep);
    writing-mode:vertical-rl;text-orientation:mixed;transition:all .2s var(--ease);
  }
  .ai-tab:hover{background:var(--pink);padding-right:20px;}
  .ai-tab .ai-tab-dot{
    width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink-light);animation:pulseDot 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .ai-tab.hidden{display:none;}
  @media (max-width:640px){
    .ai-tab{top:auto;bottom:20px;right:16px;transform:none;writing-mode:horizontal-tb;border-radius:50px;padding:14px 18px;}
  }

  .ai-overlay{
    position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(60,60,58,.35);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);z-index:199;
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s ease;
  }
  .ai-overlay.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;}

  .ai-panel{
    position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(420px, 100vw);background:var(--white);z-index:200;
    box-shadow:-8px 0 40px rgba(60,60,58,.18);display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .35s var(--ease);
  }
  .ai-panel.show{transform:translateX(0);}
  .ai-head{
    padding:22px 22px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .ai-head::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
    background-image:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,);background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  }
  .ai-head::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.86) 55%, rgba(253,218,222,.72) 140%);
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  }
  .ai-head-title, .ai-close{position:relative;z-index:2;}
  .ai-head-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
  .ai-avatar{
    width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .ai-head h3{font-size:15px;}
  .ai-head p{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--grey-soft);margin:1px 0 0;}
  .ai-close{background:none;border:none;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--grey-soft);padding:4px;line-height:1;}
  .ai-close:hover{color:var(--grey);}
  .ai-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:20px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
  .ai-msg{max-width:88%;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;}
  .ai-msg.bot{background:var(--bg-tint);align-self:flex-start;border-bottom-left-radius:4px;}
  .ai-msg.user{background:var(--pink);color:var(--white);align-self:flex-end;border-bottom-right-radius:4px;}
  .ai-msg a{color:var(--pink-dark);font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;}
  .ai-msg.bot a{color:var(--pink-dark);}
  .ai-msg .ai-source-tag{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--grey-soft);letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .ai-suggestions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:4px;}
  .ai-suggestion-btn{
    text-align:left;background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;
    padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;font-family:inherit;color:var(--grey);cursor:pointer;
    transition:all .15s ease;
  }
  .ai-suggestion-btn:hover{border-color:var(--pink);color:var(--pink-dark);background:var(--pink-tint);}
  .ai-typing{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:12px 14px;align-self:flex-start;}
  .ai-typing span{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grey-soft);animation:typingBounce 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .ai-typing span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s;}
  .ai-typing span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s;}
  @keyframes typingBounce{0%,60%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.4;}30%{transform:translateY(-4px);opacity:1;}}
  .ai-input-row{padding:16px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:8px;}
  .ai-input-row input{
    flex:1;padding:11px 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:24px;font-family:inherit;font-size:13.5px;
  }
  .ai-input-row input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--pink);}
  .ai-send{
    width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pink);color:white;border:none;cursor:pointer;
    flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px;transition:background .15s ease;
  }
  .ai-send:hover{background:var(--pink-dark);}
  .ai-jump-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:6px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ============ HOME · 01 WELCOME ============ -->

    <div class="hero-stage-scrim" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="hero-trails" aria-hidden="true"></div>

      <div class="hero-eyebrow"><span class="pulse-dot"></span>Welcome to Devoteam</div>

      <p class="sub reveal in-view" style="transition-delay:.1s;">This hub covers everything you need for your setup phase at Devoteam — accounts, tools, and what to expect through your first two months.</p>
      <div class="hero-actions reveal in-view" style="transition-delay:.18s;">
        <a href="#onboarding" class="btn btn-primary">Start my setup checklist →</a>
        <a href="#discover" class="btn btn-ghost">Discover the hub</a>
      </div>
      <div class="scroll-cue"><span class="chev">↓</span> Scroll to discover</div>
    </div>

        </a>
        <a href="#onboarding" class="journey-step" data-stage="week1">
          <div class="journey-dot"></div>

        </a>
        <a href="#onboarding" class="journey-step" data-stage="month1">
          <div class="journey-dot"></div>
          <h4>Month 1</h4>
          <p>Find your rhythm</p>
        </a>
        <a href="#onboarding" class="journey-step" data-stage="month2">

<section class="section tint anchor-offset" id="discover">

    <div class="eyebrow">Quick access</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">The essentials for your setup phase</h2>
    <div class="qa-grid">
      <a href="#tools" class="qa-card reveal reveal-stagger" style="--stagger-i:0"><span class="qa-icon">⏱️</span><div class="qa-title">AFAS</div><div class="qa-sub">Submit your hours</div></a>
      <a href="#office" class="qa-card reveal reveal-stagger" style="--stagger-i:1"><span class="qa-icon">🏢</span><div class="qa-title">Joan</div><div class="qa-sub">Book a desk or parking spot</div></a>
      <a href="#office" class="qa-card reveal reveal-stagger" style="--stagger-i:2"><span class="qa-icon">🚪</span><div class="qa-title">PalGate</div><div class="qa-sub">Access the office</div></a>
      <a href="#tools" class="qa-card reveal reveal-stagger" style="--stagger-i:3"><span class="qa-icon">🤖</span><div class="qa-title">Udemy</div><div class="qa-sub">Training &amp; certifications</div></a>
      <a href="#tools" class="qa-card reveal reveal-stagger" style="--stagger-i:4"><span class="qa-icon">💼</span><div class="qa-title">Workday</div><div class="qa-sub">Sign in</div></a>
    </div>

</section>

<!-- ============ ONBOARDING CHECKLIST ============ -->
<section class="section anchor-offset" id="onboarding">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="stage-kicker reveal"><span class="stage-num">03</span>Prepare</div>
    <div class="eyebrow">My onboarding</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Your onboarding checklist</h2>
    <p class="section-lead">Tick things off as you go. Your progress is saved automatically, so you can leave and come back whenever you like.</p>

    <div class="progress-bar-wrap">
      <div class="progress-label" id="progressLabel">0 of 0 complete</div>
      <div class="progress-bar-track"><div class="progress-bar-fill" id="progressFill"></div></div>
      <div class="progress-label" id="progressPct">0%</div>
    </div>

    <div class="checklist-groups" id="checklistGroups"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ TOOLS ============ -->
<section class="section tint anchor-offset" id="tools">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="stage-kicker reveal"><span class="stage-num">06</span>Learn</div>
    <div class="eyebrow">Your Devoteam tools</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">The tools you'll actually use</h2>
    <p class="section-lead">A handful of tools cover almost everything you'll need in your first weeks. Here's what each one is for, and when you'll need it.</p>

    <div class="tools-grid">
      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-head">
          <div class="tool-icon">⏱️</div>
          <div><div class="tool-name">AFAS</div><div class="tool-tag">ERP / finance system</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tool-desc">Devoteam's ERP and finance system — made up of the AFAS InSite web app and the AFAS Pocket mobile app. Approve a 2FA notification on your phone to log in.</p>
        <div class="tool-meta"><b>What you'll use it for:</b> Timesheets · expenses · salary slips (via My HR) · leave requests (via My HR).<br><br><b>Questions about AFAS?</b><br>Account issues — Silvia Small (HR Operations &amp; Payroll)<br>Expenses issues — Marianne Groen in 't Woud<br>Missing a client code / can't submit a timesheet — your Manager<br>Mistake on a submitted timesheet — Stefan Huijsman<br><br>More detail on accessing AFAS, submitting timesheets/expenses, and checking request status: see the <a href="https://sites.google.com/devoteam.com/nl-intranet/organisation/finance/afas-onboarding" target="_blank" style="color:var(--pink-dark);font-weight:600;">AFAS Onboarding pages on the Intranet ↗</a>.</div>
        <div class="tool-actions">
          <a href="https://40602.afasinsite.nl/" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Open AFAS InSite →</a>
          <a href="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/afas-pocket/id1028433924" target="_blank" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">📱 AFAS Pocket — App Store</a>
          <a href="https://play.google.com/store/search?q=AFAS%20Pocket&c=apps" target="_blank" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">🤖 AFAS Pocket — Google Play</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-head">
          <div class="tool-icon">🚪</div>
          <div><div class="tool-name">PalGate</div><div class="tool-tag">Office access</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tool-desc">PalGate is the app you'll use to get into the building — it replaces a physical key or badge at the door.</p>
        <div class="tool-meta"><b>When you'll need it:</b> Before your first visit to the office — install it ahead of your Welcome Day.</div>
        <div class="tool-actions">
          <a href="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/palgate/id1150352979" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">📱 PalGate — App Store</a>
          <a href="https://play.google.com/store/search?q=PalGate&c=apps" target="_blank" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">🤖 PalGate — Google Play</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-head">
          <div class="tool-icon">🏢</div>
          <div><div class="tool-name">Joan Workplace</div><div class="tool-tag">Desk &amp; parking booking</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tool-desc">Use Joan to reserve a desk for the day, or a parking spot if you're driving in.</p>
        <div class="tool-meta"><b>When you'll need it:</b> Any day you plan to come into the office.</div>
        <div class="tool-actions">
          <a href="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/joan-workplace/id1519226753" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">📱 Joan — App Store</a>
          <a href="https://play.google.com/store/search?q=Joan%20Workplace&c=apps" target="_blank" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">🤖 Joan — Google Play</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-head">
          <div class="tool-icon">💼</div>
          <div><div class="tool-name">Workday</div><div class="tool-tag">Sign-in portal</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tool-desc">Devoteam's core HR system. View and update your personal details, manage your professional history, and upload certificates. Align on performance, goals and feedback directly with your manager here too.</p>
        <div class="tool-meta"><b>When you'll need it:</b> Right away — your Welcome Day wrap-up to-do list runs through Workday (see the checklist).</div>
        <div class="tool-actions">
          <a href="https://wd3.myworkday.com/wday/authgwy/devoteam/login.htmld" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Open Workday →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card mandatory">
        <div class="tool-head">
          <div class="tool-icon">🤖</div>
          <div><div class="tool-name">Udemy</div><div class="tool-tag">Training &amp; certification</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tool-desc">Udemy is where you'll complete Devoteam's training and certifications — starting with one that's mandatory for everyone.</p>
        <div class="tool-meta"><span class="badge-mandatory">Mandatory</span><br><br><b>GenAI Level 1 Certification</b> — get certified within your first month. Devoteam uses Gemini directly inside Google Workspace, so this course covers the essentials of working with AI, including using Gemini effectively. Start during your first weeks to get up to speed quickly.</div>
        <div class="tool-actions">
          <a href="https://devoteamlearning.udemy.com/organization/home/" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Go to Udemy →</a>
          <a href="https://sites.google.com/devoteam.com/group-intranet/infinite-possibilities/learning/ai-upskilling-program?authuser=0" target="_blank" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">AI Upskilling Program (Intranet)</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-head">
          <div class="tool-icon">🗂️</div>
          <div><div class="tool-name">Google Workspace</div><div class="tool-tag">Everyday collaboration</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tool-desc">Your central platform for everyday tasks and continuous collaboration — real-time document sharing, integrated chat, and secure cloud storage drive day-to-day work at Devoteam.</p>
        <div class="tool-meta"><b>When you'll need it:</b> From day one — it's how the company communicates internally.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-head">
          <div class="tool-icon">📰</div>
          <div><div class="tool-name">Local Intranet</div><div class="tool-tag">Netherlands hub</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tool-desc">Your main hub for country-specific resources — templates, employee policies, internal news, and NL-specific work tools, including the AFAS Onboarding pages.</p>
        <div class="tool-meta"><b>When you'll need it:</b> Whenever you need an NL-specific answer.</div>
        <div class="tool-actions">
          <a href="https://sites.google.com/devoteam.com/nl-intranet/home" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Open NL Intranet →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-head">
          <div class="tool-icon">🌍</div>
          <div><div class="tool-name">Devoteam Group Intranet</div><div class="tool-tag">Company-wide hub</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tool-desc">The global Devoteam intranet — company-wide news, resources, and the "Infinite Possibilities" pages (including Learning and Career, linked elsewhere in this hub).</p>
        <div class="tool-meta"><b>When you'll need it:</b> For anything that isn't NL-specific.</div>
        <div class="tool-actions">
          <a href="https://sites.google.com/devoteam.com/group-intranet" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Open Group Intranet →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-head">
          <div class="tool-icon">🧩</div>
          <div><div class="tool-name">Apps Portal</div><div class="tool-tag">Application access</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tool-desc">Your central portal for Devoteam's business applications. <span class="placeholder">Exact scope TO BE CONFIRMED</span></p>
        <div class="tool-actions">
          <a href="https://appsportal.devoteam.com/" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Open Apps Portal →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tool-card">
        <div class="tool-head">
          <div class="tool-icon">🧑‍💻</div>
          <div><div class="tool-name">Whoz</div><div class="tool-tag">Staffing &amp; skills</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tool-desc">Devoteam's staffing and skills management platform — keep your profile, skills and project availability up to date here.</p>
        <div class="tool-actions">
          <a href="https://www.whoz.com" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Open Whoz →</a>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ FIRST TWO MONTHS TIMELINE ============ -->
<section class="section anchor-offset" id="learning">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="stage-kicker reveal"><span class="stage-num">05</span>Your First Days</div>
    <div class="eyebrow">Setup phase</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Your first two months</h2>
    <p class="section-lead">What to focus on, stage by stage, while you're getting set up.</p>

    <div class="timeline">
      <div class="tl-row">
        <div class="tl-marker"><div class="tl-day">Day 1</div><div class="tl-label">First day</div></div>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h4>Get set up</h4>
          <ul>
            <li><strong>Focus:</strong> Get familiar with Devoteam and make sure you have everything you need to get started.</li>
            <li><strong>Actions:</strong> Set up your Devoteam account, install PalGate and Joan, and log into AFAS and Workday.</li>
            <li><strong>Meetings:</strong> Welcome meeting with your manager, meet your Team Coach and team, and meet your buddy (if applicable).</li>
            <li><strong>HR/People:</strong> Complete your Day 1 HR onboarding, review key practical information and employment conditions, and get familiar with your HR/People points of contact.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tl-row">
        <div class="tl-marker"><div class="tl-day">Week 1</div><div class="tl-label">First week</div></div>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h4>Get connected</h4>
          <ul>
            <li><strong>Focus:</strong> Get to know your team, your role and how we work together.</li>
            <li><strong>Training:</strong> Start with the GenAI Level 1 training.</li>
            <li><strong>Getting to know people:</strong> Attend Welcome Day, meet your manager and Team Coach, and start building your internal network.</li>
            <li><strong>Certifications:</strong> Review the certifications relevant to your role and align with your manager on your certification and development path.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tl-row">
        <div class="tl-marker"><div class="tl-day">Month 1</div><div class="tl-label">First month</div></div>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h4>Find your rhythm</h4>
          <ul>
            <li><strong>Focus:</strong> Get comfortable in your role, your project and Devoteam's ways of working.</li>
            <li><strong>Suggested actions:</strong> Have your first onboarding check-in with your manager and Team Coach, clarify your role and expectations, get familiar with your client/project, and identify any areas where you need additional support or training.</li>
            <li><strong>HR/People activities:</strong> Complete your 1-month onboarding check-in, make sure your HR information and benefits are correctly set up, complete any outstanding onboarding activities, and share feedback on your onboarding experience.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tl-row">
        <div class="tl-marker"><div class="tl-day">Month 2</div><div class="tl-label">Two months in</div></div>
        <div class="tl-body">
          <h4>Settle in fully</h4>
          <ul>
            <li><strong>Focus:</strong> Build confidence in your day-to-day role, widen your network and start thinking about your development at Devoteam.</li>
            <li><strong>Suggested actions:</strong> Review your progress and first achievements with your manager, discuss feedback from your team or client, set initial development goals, explore relevant learning or certification opportunities, and get involved in communities, initiatives or events that interest you.</li>
            <li><strong>Meetings:</strong> Have your 2-month onboarding check-in with your manager and Team Coach, and discuss your development and next steps.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--grey-soft);margin-top:16px;">Looking for guidance beyond month two (first 90 days, first year)? That's out of scope for this version of the hub — ask your People Lead in the meantime.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ FINANCE & PAY ============ -->
<section class="section tint anchor-offset" id="finance">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="eyebrow">Finance &amp; pay</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Getting set up as a new joiner (NL)</h2>
    <p class="section-lead">Covered by Marc Bovy, CFO, during Welcome Day.</p>

    <div class="hr-grid" style="margin-top:28px;">
      <div class="hr-card">
        <h4>🪪 BSN &amp; bank account</h4>
        <p>A BSN (fiscal number) is required. HR (Melissa Posdijk) helps you apply for a fiscal BSN and a Dutch bank account.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hr-card">
        <h4>💶 Tax advantage &amp; relocation</h4>
        <p>Silvia Small (HR) applies for the 30% ruling if applicable, after your first salary run — your salary is paid from your start date as if it's already granted. A relocation allowance can be paid on request, generally once you have a Dutch bank account, subject to repayment.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hr-card">
        <h4>🏦 Pension</h4>
        <p>You're automatically enrolled in the collective pension scheme with A.S.R. DoenPensioen. You'll get a personal welcome email with instructions within 6 weeks of starting.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hr-card">
        <h4>🩺 Healthcare</h4>
        <p>Personal healthcare insurance is mandatory in the Netherlands. Arrange your own, or use Devoteam's collective insurance for slightly lower premiums (intermediary: Schouten Zekerheid — CZ/Menzis). If you're joining from abroad, contact them as soon as possible. Deduction starts after activation, which can take a few months — expect a catch-up charge.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hr-card">
        <h4>💳 Salary</h4>
        <p>Payment date is the <b>25th of each month</b>. Your slip is available in English or Dutch via AFAS InSite and the AFAS Pocket app. Healthcare premiums and pension contributions are deducted monthly, and expenses are paid out with your salary. Silvia Small (HR) is happy to walk you through it any time.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="hr-card">
        <h4>🚗 Commuting &amp; mileage</h4>
        <p>Lease car: no recurring public transport costs, unless your assignment is far from home. Own car: claim mileage via AFAS. Parking costs are claimable — but be cost-efficient (cheapest, not nearest). Public transport: use your OV-Chipcard and download travel costs/expenses via AFAS. Full detail in the Car &amp; Commuting Allowance policy (an addendum to the Employee Handbook).</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:44px;">Finance team</div>
    <div class="hr-grid">
      <div class="hr-card"><h4>Marc Bovy</h4><p>CFO — Controller, Financial Reporting.</p></div>
      <div class="hr-card"><h4>Silvia Small</h4><p>HR Operations &amp; Payroll — AFAS InSite rollout, salary questions.</p></div>
      <div class="hr-card"><h4>Marianne Groen in 't Woud</h4><p>Financial Assistant &amp; Fleet Manager — expenses, lease cars.</p></div>
      <div class="hr-card"><h4>Stefan Huijsman</h4><p>Controller — mistakes on submitted timesheets.</p></div>
      <div class="hr-card"><h4>Jeroen Veeneman</h4><p>Finance Manager.</p></div>
      <div class="hr-card"><h4>Claudia van der Louw</h4><p>Business Operations — invoicing &amp; collection.</p></div>
    </div>

/* ============ STORAGE HELPERS ============ */
/* Uses localStorage (works on any real static deployment, e.g. GitHub Pages).
   window.storage only exists inside Claude.ai's artifact sandbox — never use it here. */
const STORAGE_KEY = "onboarding-checklist-state";
async function loadState(){
  try{
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  }catch(e){ return {}; }
}
async function saveState(state){
  try{ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); }
  catch(e){ console.error("storage save failed", e); }
}

let state = {};
let openGroups = new Set([checklistData[0].key]);

/* ============ RENDER CHECKLIST ============ */
function renderChecklist(){
  const container = document.getElementById("checklistGroups");
  container.innerHTML = "";
  checklistData.forEach((group, gi) => {
    const groupEl = document.createElement("div");
    groupEl.className = "cl-group" + (openGroups.has(group.key) ? " open":"");
    const doneCount = group.items.filter((_,ii)=>state[group.key+"-"+ii]).length;
    groupEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="cl-group-header">
        <h3>${group.title}</h3>
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;">
          <span class="cl-group-count">${doneCount}/${group.items.length}</span>
          <span class="cl-group-chevron">▾</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="cl-group-body">
        ${group.items.map((item, ii) => {
          const id = group.key+"-"+ii;
          const checked = !!state[id];
          return `<div class="cl-item">
            <div class="cl-checkbox ${checked?'checked':''}" data-id="${id}"></div>
            <div class="cl-text ${checked?'done':''}" data-id="${id}">${item}</div>
          </div>`;
        }).join("")}
      </div>
    `;
    groupEl.querySelector(".cl-group-header").addEventListener("click", () => {
      if(openGroups.has(group.key)) openGroups.delete(group.key);
      else openGroups.add(group.key);
      groupEl.classList.toggle("open");
    });
    groupEl.querySelectorAll(".cl-checkbox, .cl-text").forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
        const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
        state[id] = !state[id];
        await saveState(state);
        renderChecklist();
        updateProgress();
      });
    });
    container.appendChild(groupEl);
  });
}

function updateProgress(){
  let total = 0, done = 0;
  const stageProgress = { day1:[0,0], week1:[0,0], month1:[0,0], month2:[0,0] };
  checklistData.forEach(group => {
    group.items.forEach((_, ii) => {
      total++;
      const id = group.key+"-"+ii;
      const isDone = !!state[id];
      if(isDone) done++;
      if(stageProgress[group.stage]){
        stageProgress[group.stage][1]++;
        if(isDone) stageProgress[group.stage][0]++;
      }
    });
  });
  const pct = total ? Math.round((done/total)*100) : 0;
  document.getElementById("progressLabel").textContent = `${done} of ${total} complete`;
  document.getElementById("progressPct").textContent = `${pct}%`;
  document.getElementById("progressFill").style.width = pct + "%";

  // journey fill: overall pct maps to line width; mark filled stages when their own items are 100% done
  document.getElementById("journeyFill").style.width = pct + "%";
  document.querySelectorAll(".journey-step").forEach(stepEl => {
    const stage = stepEl.dataset.stage;
    const sp = stageProgress[stage];
    if(sp && sp[1] > 0 && sp[0] === sp[1]){
      stepEl.classList.add("filled");
    } else {
      stepEl.classList.remove("filled");
    }
  });
}

/* ============ FAQ ============ */
function renderFAQ(filter=""){
  const list = document.getElementById("faqList");
  const f = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
  list.innerHTML = "";
  let anyVisible = false;
  faqData.forEach((item, i) => {
    const matches = !f || item.q.toLowerCase().includes(f) || item.keywords.includes(f);
    if(!matches) return;
    anyVisible = true;
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "faq-item";
    el.innerHTML = `
      <div class="faq-q">${item.q}<span class="faq-chevron">▾</span></div>
      <div class="faq-a"><div class="faq-a-inner">${item.a}</div></div>
    `;
    el.querySelector(".faq-q").addEventListener("click", () => el.classList.toggle("open"));
    list.appendChild(el);
  });
  if(!anyVisible){
    list.innerHTML = `<div class="search-empty">No matching questions. Try a different word.</div>`;
  }
}
document.getElementById("faqSearch").addEventListener("input", (e) => renderFAQ(e.target.value));

/* ============ GLOBAL SEARCH ============ */
const globalSearch = document.getElementById("globalSearch");
const searchResults = document.getElementById("searchResults");
globalSearch.addEventListener("input", () => {
  const q = globalSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if(!q){ searchResults.classList.remove("show"); return; }
  const matches = searchIndex.filter(item => item.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || item.sub.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  searchResults.innerHTML = matches.length
    ? matches.map(m => `<div class="search-result-item" data-target="${m.target}"><div class="r-title">${m.title}</div><div class="r-sub">${m.sub}</div></div>`).join("")
    : `<div class="search-empty">No results for "${q}"</div>`;
  searchResults.classList.add("show");
  searchResults.querySelectorAll(".search-result-item").forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener("click", () => {
      document.querySelector(el.dataset.target).scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});
      searchResults.classList.remove("show");
      globalSearch.value = "";
    });
  });
});
document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  if(!e.target.closest(".search-box")) searchResults.classList.remove("show");
});

/* Build the fixed journey rail (desktop only, shown via CSS media query) */
const railEl = document.createElement("div");
railEl.className = "journey-rail";
railEl.id = "journeyRail";
journeyMap.filter(s => s.railLabel).forEach(s => {
  const dot = document.createElement("a");
  dot.className = "rail-dot";
  dot.href = "#" + s.id;
  dot.dataset.id = s.id;
  dot.innerHTML = `<span class="rail-label">${s.railLabel}</span>`;
  railEl.appendChild(dot);
});
document.body.appendChild(railEl);

window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
  let current = journeyMap[0];
  journeyMap.forEach(s => {
    const el = document.getElementById(s.id);
    if(el && window.scrollY >= el.offsetTop - 140) current = s;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".nav-links a").forEach(a => {
    a.classList.toggle("active", a.getAttribute("href") === current.navHref);
  });
  // rail dot: highlight the nearest stage that actually has a rail dot
  let railCurrent = journeyMap.filter(s => s.railLabel)[0].id;
  journeyMap.filter(s => s.railLabel).forEach(s => {
    const el = document.getElementById(s.id);
    if(el && window.scrollY >= el.offsetTop - 140) railCurrent = s.id;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".rail-dot").forEach(d => {
    d.classList.toggle("active", d.dataset.id === railCurrent);
  });
}, { passive:true });

/* ============ SCROLL REVEAL ============ */
const revealSelectors = ".tool-card, .hr-card, .contact-card, .faq-item, .cl-group, .tl-row, .qa-card, .section-lead";
document.querySelectorAll(revealSelectors).forEach(el => {
  if(!el.classList.contains("reveal")) el.classList.add("reveal");
});
// stagger index within each direct parent container
const containers = new Set();
document.querySelectorAll(revealSelectors).forEach(el => containers.add(el.parentElement));
containers.forEach(parent => {
  let i = 0;
  Array.from(parent.children).forEach(child => {
    if(child.classList && child.classList.contains("reveal") && !child.style.getPropertyValue("--stagger-i")){
      child.classList.add("reveal-stagger");
      child.style.setProperty("--stagger-i", i);
      i++;
    }
  });
});
const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if(entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.classList.add("in-view");
      revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold:0.12, rootMargin:"0px 0px -40px 0px" });
document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

/* ============ TEXT REVEAL (clip-path mask wipe on section titles) ============ */
document.querySelectorAll("h2.section-title").forEach(el => {
  el.classList.add("text-reveal");
  el.innerHTML = '<span class="text-reveal-inner">' + el.innerHTML + '</span>';
});
document.querySelectorAll(".text-reveal").forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

/* ============================================================
   AI COMPANION
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Architecture:
   - This file is static (no build step, no server). A real static
     deploy (e.g. GitHub Pages) CANNOT hold a secret API key in the
     frontend — so this component never calls the Anthropic API
     directly.
   - Instead it POSTs to AI_CHAT_ENDPOINT (a relative path). If you
     deploy a small serverless function there (Vercel/Netlify/
     Cloudflare Worker) that calls the Anthropic API server-side,
     with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set as a SERVER-SIDE environment
     variable (never in this file), you get full conversational AI.
     See AI-COMPANION-SETUP.md (shipped alongside this file) for a
     ready-to-deploy example function.
   - Without a backend, it automatically falls back to an
     *extractive* answer built only from aiKnowledge below — it
     never invents information, it just surfaces the most relevant
     real content from the Hub and links you to it.
   ============================================================ */
const AI_CHAT_ENDPOINT = "/api/chat";

const aiKnowledge = [
  ...faqData.map(f => ({ title:f.q, content:f.a, target:null })),
  { title:"Day 1 focus", content:"Day 1 is about getting set up: set up your Devoteam account, install PalGate/Joan/AFAS Pocket, log into AFAS and Workday, have your welcome meeting with your manager, meet your Team Coach, team and buddy, and complete your Day 1 HR onboarding.", target:"#onboarding" },
  { title:"Week 1 focus", content:"Week 1 is about getting connected: attend Welcome Day, start the GenAI Level 1 training, start building your internal network, and align with your manager on your certification and development path.", target:"#learning" },
  { title:"Month 1 focus", content:"Month 1 is about finding your rhythm: have your 1-month onboarding check-in with your manager and Team Coach, clarify your role and expectations, get familiar with your client/project, and make sure your HR info and benefits are set up.", target:"#learning" },
  { title:"Month 2 focus", content:"Month 2 is about settling in fully: review your progress with your manager, discuss feedback, set initial development goals, explore learning opportunities, and have your 2-month onboarding check-in.", target:"#learning" },
  { title:"AFAS", content:"AFAS is Devoteam's ERP and finance system (InSite web app + Pocket mobile app). Use it for timesheets, expenses, salary slips and leave requests. Log in with a 2FA approval on your phone.", target:"#tools" },
  { title:"PalGate", content:"PalGate is the app for office building access. Download it before your first office visit.", target:"#office" },
  { title:"Joan Workplace", content:"Joan is used to book a desk and/or parking spot. Reserve before you travel, and check in via Joan on the day — otherwise your booking is cancelled.", target:"#office" },
  { title:"Workday", content:"Workday is Devoteam's core HR system — update your personal details, professional history and certificates, and align on performance and goals with your manager.", target:"#tools" },
  { title:"Google Workspace", content:"Devoteam's central platform for everyday collaboration — docs, chat and cloud storage.", target:"#tools" },
  { title:"GenAI Level 1 certification", content:"A mandatory Udemy course on using Gemini/GenAI responsibly, to be completed within your first month.", target:"#tools" },
  { title:"NL Intranet & Group Intranet", content:"The NL Intranet covers Netherlands-specific resources; the Group Intranet covers company-wide news and the Infinite Possibilities pages (Learning, Career).", target:"#tools" },
  { title:"Apps Portal", content:"Devoteam's central portal for business applications.", target:"#tools" },
  { title:"Whoz", content:"Devoteam's staffing and skills platform — keep your profile, skills and project availability up to date.", target:"#tools" },
  { title:"Finance & Pay", content:"Salary is paid on the 25th of each month, visible via AFAS InSite/Pocket. You're auto-enrolled in the A.S.R. DoenPensioen pension scheme (welcome email within 6 weeks). Healthcare insurance is mandatory in NL. HR (Melissa Posdijk) helps with your BSN and Dutch bank account.", target:"#finance" },
  { title:"Who is HR / my People Lead", content:"HR Netherlands: nl.hr@devoteam.com. Your People Lead — confirmed in your first week — is your go-to for development, career and feedback conversations.", target:"#people" },
  { title:"Our values", content:"Respect, Entrepreneurship, Collaboration, Ambition, Frankness.", target:"#people" },
  { title:"Office locations", content:"NL headquarters: John M. Keynesplein 10, Amsterdam. There's also a small Zuidas office at Claude Debussylaan, mostly used by Sales.", target:"#office" },
  { title:"Home office gear", content:"Devoteam works hybrid — client, office or home — and supports you in setting up your home office.", target:"#office" },
  { title:"IT support", content:"IT Support Desk: 00 33 1 41 49 55 55.", target:"#contacts" },
  { title:"Confidants / Trustees", content:"For confidential or sensitive matters: Lara Meijer and Sven Hoeboer. Find their contact details via G-Suite or Google Contacts.", target:"#contacts" },
];

function aiScore(query, entry){
  const text = (entry.title + " " + entry.content).toLowerCase();
  const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
  if(!q) return 0;
  let score = 0;
  q.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 2).forEach(w => { if(text.includes(w)) score += 1; });
  if(text.includes(q)) score += 3;
  return score;
}
function aiRetrieve(query, n=4){
  return aiKnowledge
    .map(e => ({ ...e, score: aiScore(query, e) }))
    .filter(e => e.score > 0)
    .sort((a,b) => b.score - a.score)
    .slice(0, n);
}

async function askCompanion(question){
  const matches = aiRetrieve(question, 4);
  try{
    const res = await fetch(AI_CHAT_ENDPOINT, {
      method:"POST",
      headers:{ "Content-Type":"application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ question, context: matches.map(m => ({ title:m.title, content:m.content })) })
    });
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error("no backend configured");
    const data = await res.json();
    return { html: data.reply, mode:"ai" };
  }catch(e){
    if(matches.length === 0){
      return { html:"I couldn't find anything about that in the Hub yet. Try asking about your checklist, tools, Finance &amp; Pay, or People &amp; HR — or use the search bar in the header.", mode:"fallback" };
    }
    const top = matches[0];
    let html = `<strong>${top.title}</strong><br>${top.content}`;
    if(top.target) html += `<br><a href="${top.target}" class="ai-jump-link">Jump to this section →</a>`;
    if(matches.length > 1){
      html += `<span class="ai-source-tag">Related: ${matches.slice(1).map(m=>m.title).join(" · ")}</span>`;
    }
    return { html, mode:"fallback" };
  }
}

const contextualSuggestions = {
  home:       ["What do I need to do before my first day?", "Show me my checklist", "What tools will I use?"],
  discover:   ["What's AFAS for?", "How do I access the office?", "Where do I log my hours?"],
  onboarding: ["What do I need to do before my first day?", "What happens on Day 1?", "Who should I contact for an IT issue?"],
  people:     ["Who is my People Lead?", "What are Devoteam's values?", "Who is HR?"],
  learning:   ["What should I expect during my first week?", "When is the GenAI certification due?", "What happens in month 2?"],
  tools:      ["Where can I find the training catalogue?", "What is Workday for?", "How do I access AFAS?"],
  finance:    ["Where can I find information about expenses?", "When do I get paid?", "What about my pension?"],
  office:     ["How do I book a desk?", "Where is the Amsterdam office?", "What about home office gear?"],
  contacts:   ["Who should I contact for an IT issue?", "Who can help with HR questions?", "I don't know where to start — help me."],
  faq:        ["Which certification do I need to complete?", "How do I reserve a desk?", "Where do I register my hours?"],
};

function aiCurrentSection(){
  let current = "home";
  journeyMap.forEach(s => {
    const el = document.getElementById(s.id);
    if(el && window.scrollY >= el.offsetTop - 140) current = s.id;
  });
  return current;
}

const aiTab = document.getElementById("aiTab");
const aiOverlay = document.getElementById("aiOverlay");
const aiPanel = document.getElementById("aiPanel");
const aiClose = document.getElementById("aiClose");
const aiBody = document.getElementById("aiBody");
const aiInput = document.getElementById("aiInput");
const aiSend = document.getElementById("aiSend");
let aiHasGreeted = false;

function aiAddMessage(html, sender){
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "ai-msg " + sender;
  el.innerHTML = html;
  aiBody.appendChild(el);
  aiBody.scrollTop = aiBody.scrollHeight;
  return el;
}
function aiAddSuggestions(list){
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "ai-suggestions";
  list.forEach(q => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.className = "ai-suggestion-btn";
    b.textContent = q;
    b.addEventListener("click", () => aiHandleQuestion(q));
    wrap.appendChild(b);
  });
  aiBody.appendChild(wrap);
  aiBody.scrollTop = aiBody.scrollHeight;
}
function aiGreet(){
  if(aiHasGreeted) return;
  aiHasGreeted = true;
  const section = aiCurrentSection();
  aiAddMessage("Hi 👋 I'm your New Joiner Companion. I answer using this Hub's own content — I'll say so if something isn't in here yet. Need a hand with any of these?", "bot");
  aiAddSuggestions(contextualSuggestions[section] || contextualSuggestions.home);
}
async function aiHandleQuestion(question){
  if(!question || !question.trim()) return;
  aiAddMessage(question.replace(/</g,"&lt;"), "user");
  aiInput.value = "";
  const typing = aiAddMessage(`<div class="ai-typing"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>`, "bot");
  typing.style.padding = "0";
  typing.style.background = "transparent";
  const { html, mode } = await askCompanion(question);
  typing.remove();
  const tag = mode === "fallback" ? `<span class="ai-source-tag">From the Hub content (no AI backend configured)</span>` : "";
  aiAddMessage(html + tag, "bot");
}
function aiOpen(){
  aiOverlay.classList.add("show");
  aiPanel.classList.add("show");
  aiTab.classList.add("hidden");
  aiGreet();
  setTimeout(() => aiInput.focus(), 300);
}
function aiCloseFn(){
  aiOverlay.classList.remove("show");
  aiPanel.classList.remove("show");
  aiTab.classList.remove("hidden");
}
aiTab.addEventListener("click", aiOpen);
aiClose.addEventListener("click", aiCloseFn);
aiOverlay.addEventListener("click", aiCloseFn);
aiSend.addEventListener("click", () => aiHandleQuestion(aiInput.value));
aiInput.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if(e.key === "Enter") aiHandleQuestion(aiInput.value); });
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if(e.key === "Escape") aiCloseFn(); });
aiBody.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const link = e.target.closest(".ai-jump-link");
  if(link){
    e.preventDefault();
    aiCloseFn();
    setTimeout(() => document.querySelector(link.getAttribute("href"))?.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"}), 200);
  }
});

/* ============ INIT ============ */
(async function init(){
  state = await loadState();
  renderChecklist();
  updateProgress();
  renderFAQ();
})();
</script>
